eps.d: Arkenfield Stables' trainer Mike Hardy solves the mystery of a problem horse.

eps.t: All I Need is One Good Horse
eps.d: Arkenfield Stables' trainer Mike Hardy solves the mystery of a problem horse.
Rachel's step-son sells tainted feed to one of Mike's horses.
Horse owner James Brant insists that Mike trains his horses only.
After a horse opens as favourite, a betting owner suspects someone is sharing information with a bookie.
A local boxing championship leads to large bets.
Mike loses his position after buying a lame horse at a high price.
A newspaper's publicity results in unwanted trouble for Arkenfield.
Mike's relationship with horse owner Patti Roman turns from business to pleasure.

eps.t: A Little Touch of Magic in the Night
eps.d: Gypsies use Arkenfield horses to run in secret night races that tire them out for their track races.
Loan shark Malcolm Burns attempts to pull off a betting coup with John Grey.
Mike and Francis rekindle their relationship while looking for a potential race horse.

eps.t: No Way to Treat a Lady
eps.d: Mike's last minute decision to replace a jockey for an important race backfires.
The disappearance of James Brant leaves Arkenfield up for liquidation.
Mike makes a deal about Arkenfield with Courtlands Bank; Mike's wife returns.
A Belfast employee threatens Joe to fix a race; Tom is found.
Robert proposes to Rachel; Sally leaves for Australia.
Joe must fix a race to save his sister; a winning horse is disqualified.
Rachel suspects David was murdered; Joe learns his sister set him up.
Mo worries about her future; Rachel answers Robert's proposal.
John's trial; Mo returns from the hospital but cannot ride.
Robert and Rachel's wedding; Mo leaves for France to ride Dangerous Lady.
The police find evidence linking Robert to David's death.
